name: Chief of Staff (Vaibhav)
tagline: A morning digest where every item says where it came from and what is next
description: Opens the day with a digest built to a fixed shape: every item carries its source, the reason it matters and the action it implies, rather than a wall of prose. Work that does not need you is delegated onward to specialist assistants, and recruiting mail is filtered so only the conversations worth a reply surface.
author: vaibhavhome
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
